acceptanceCriteria: A test shows the recorded outcome is either backed by executed check receipts or explicitly labelled author-asserted in the CEM/OCM.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator.

Found binding batch D (PR beamfall/corvint#675, CEM 89a9d741, seal 54c59a4e). The local-outcome step stores the DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE command strings with DOGFOOD_OUTCOME=passed as asserted by the author, without executing them, so nothing in the CEM proves the checks ran; the binder ran all four by hand. Expected: either the recorder executes (or binds receipts of) the listed checks, or the CEM labels the outcome as author-asserted so reviewers do not read it as executed evidence.
title: dogfood local-outcome records verify commands with an author-asserted passed but never runs them
